ain: noun. Alternative form of ayin (“Semitic letter”).
air: noun. The substance constituting Earth 's atmosphere: a gaseous mixture of nitrogen, oxygen, and various trace gases.
ana: noun. A collection of things associated with a person or place, especially a personal collection of anecdotes or conversations at table
ani: noun. Any bird of the genus Crotophaga in the cuckoo family.
anoa: noun. Either of two related species of small Indonesian water buffalo similar in appearance to deer; Bubalus quarlesi or Bubalus depressicornis.
anopia: noun. State or condition of sightlessness, often due to medical reasons.
apron: noun. An article of clothing worn over the front of the torso and/or legs for protection from spills; also historically worn by Freemasons and as part of women's fashion.
aria: noun. A musical piece written typically for a solo voice with orchestral accompaniment in an opera or cantata.
inro: noun. A small decorative box, hung from the sash of a kimono, for holding small objects.
ion: noun. An atom or group of atoms bearing an electrical charge, such as the sodium and chlorine atoms in a salt solution.
iron: noun. A common, inexpensive metal, silvery grey when untarnished, that rusts, is attracted by magnets, and is used in making steel: a chemical element having atomic number 26 and symbol Fe.
naira: noun. The official currency of Nigeria.
nap: verb. To have a nap; to sleep for a short period of time, especially during the day.
nip: verb. To catch and enclose or compress tightly between two surfaces, or points which are brought together or closed; to pinch; to close in upon.
nipa: noun. A palm tree of the species Nypa fruticans.
noir: adjective. Of or pertaining to film noir, or the atmosphere associated with that genre
nor: conjunction. And... not (introducing a negative statement, without necessarily following one).
nori: noun. A type of seaweed, a red alga, laver (genus Pyropia, including species P. yezoensis and P. tenera).
noria: noun. A treadwheel with attached buckets, used to raise and deposit water.
oar: noun. A type of lever used to propel a boat, having a flat blade at one end and a handle at the other, and pivoted in a rowlock atop the gunwale, whereby a rower seated in the boat and pulling the handle can pass the blade through the water by repeated strokes against the water's resistance, thus moving the boat.
orpin: noun. Alternative form of orpine (“the plant or the pigment”).
pain: noun. An ache or bodily suffering, or an instance of this; an unpleasant sensation, resulting from a derangement of functions, disease, or injury by violence; hurt.
pair: noun. Two alike or identical things taken together; often followed by of.
pan: noun. A wide, flat receptacle used around the house, especially for cooking.
para: noun. A former subunit of currency in several countries in the Ottoman/Turkish and Yugoslav regions.
paranoia: noun. A psychotic disorder, now called delusional disorder, often (in one of six subtypes) characterized by delusions of persecution and a perceived threat against the individual affected with the disorder, and often associated with false accusations and a general mistrust of others.
pia: noun. The pia mater, the innermost of the meninges that protect the brain and spinal cord.
piano: noun. A percussive keyboard musical instrument, usually ranging over seven octaves, with white and black colored keys, played by pressing these keys, causing hammers to strike strings.
pin: noun. A needle without an eye (usually) made of drawn-out steel wire with one end sharpened and the other flattened or rounded into a head, used for fastening.
pion: noun. Any of three semistable mesons, having positive, negative or neutral charge, composed of up and down quarks / antiquarks.
pirn: noun. A cone-shaped spool or bobbin on which thread or yarn is wound, used most often for weaving.
poi: noun. The traditional staple food of Hawaii, made by baking and pounding the kalo (or taro) root, and reducing it to a thin paste, which is allowed to ferment.
prion: noun. A self-propagating misfolded conformer of a protein that is responsible for a number of diseases that affect the brain and other neural tissue.
pro: noun. An advantage of something, especially when contrasted with its disadvantages (cons).
proa: noun. A sailing vessel found in the waters of Micronesia and Indonesia; it has a single, large outrigger and a triangular sail.
raia: noun. Alternative form of raya (“type of historical territory”).
rain: noun. Condensed water falling from a cloud.
rani: noun. The wife of a rajah.
rap: noun. A sharp blow with something hard.
ria: noun. A narrow inlet of the sea formed by a flooded unglaciated river valley.
rip: verb. To divide or separate the parts of (especially something flimsy, such as paper or fabric), by cutting or tearing; to tear off or out by violence.
roan: adjective. Having a coat of a dark base color with individual white hairs mixed in.
airan: noun. A Turkish cold drink made from yoghurt and water with salt and sometimes herbs.
apa: noun. A title used for male clergy or saints in the Coptic Church.
apar: noun. The three-banded armadillo, Tolypeutes matacus
apio: noun. Synonym of akpeteshie (“Ghanaian alcoholic drink”).
aponia: noun. The absence of pain considered as a state of spiritual serenity
aporia: noun. An expression of deliberation with oneself regarding uncertainty or doubt as to how to proceed.
ara: noun. The great blue and yellow macaw (Ara ararauna).
arni: noun. The wild water buffalo (Bubalus arnee)
naio: noun. Myoporum sandwicense, a flowering plant in the figwort family.
napa: noun. Brassica rapa subsp. pekinensis, a kind of Chinese cabbage.
noa: adjective. Non-taboo; serving to replace a taboo name or term.
oni: noun. A Japanese evil spirit or demon.
paar: noun. A hypothesized shifting of four geologic blocks: northeast Africa west of Red Sea and north of the Ethiopian valley, the Arabian Peninsula, the Sinai Peninsula, and the Horn of Africa east of the rift valleys, which is used to explain the structural features of the area.
parao: noun. A sailing vessel found in the waters of the Philippines, similar to a proa.
pir: noun. A Muslim holy man or religious leader, especially Sufi.
poa: noun. Any grass of the genus Poa, especially Poa annua.
pon: noun. A call for forming a set of three identical tiles using a discarded tile.
prana: noun. Respiration, breathing, seen as a life principle or life force.
rio: noun. Alternative form of ryō (“Japanese ounce”).
ropani: noun. A unit of area equal to 5476 square feet or roughly 0.126 acres.
